svg.title: Ingestion pipeline, fail closed
svg.desc: Documents flow from Word/PDF sources through LangChain loading, cleaning, gates, redaction, section-aware chunking, embedding, Pydantic validation, staging, promotion, safe search and verification. Documents that fail a gate or validation are sent to quarantine.
svg.text: Every Word/PDF is loaded, gated, chunked, embedded and validated, or it goes to quarantine. Search only sees promoted chunks.
